summary: The diff implements a single-page React + TS landing page with hero/message/reasons/proposal/footer sections, a romantic rose/pink/cream theme, and a client-side proposal interaction. However, the required generated image assets are not shown as added under the specified public assets path, and several unrequested backend/auth-related features were added despite the request being client-side only and explicitly listing auth as a non-goal.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add required generated images as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated with the specified filenames and incorporate them into the page design.
missing_requirements.reason: The code references the required images (via /assets/generated/...), but the diff summary does not show any new files added under frontend/public/assets/generated, so the actual required image assets are not evidenced as present.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend canister file added (empty actor), despite backend changes not being required and the solution requested to be client-side only.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly says backend changes are not required; diff adds backend/main.mo.

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity / authentication plumbing and actor creation hooks added and wired into the app.
hallucinated_features.reason: Non-goals explicitly include authentication/Internet Identity flows, yet the diff adds InternetIdentityProvider, useInternetIdentity, useActor, and React Query setup for actor management.
Not requested in the BuildRequest requirements or acceptance criteria.
